environment.description: Same Python 3.11 service on EC2 behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule with priority 1 that uses a RegexPatternSet matching body content where 'inherit' field is set to true in combination with a 'parent' reference pointing to a non-existent stage name. Additionally, the AWS-AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet is enabled in COUNT mode (not block), and a separate rate-based rule limits to 100 req/5min per IP. The critical control is a custom WAFv2 rule using a JsonBody match scope targeting $.stages[*].payload.inherit with a ByteMatchStatement for the string 'true' combined with a SizeConstraint on $.stages[*].parent that triggers when the referenced value does NOT appear elsewhere in $.stages[*].name — implemented via a regex negative lookahead pattern in a RegexMatchStatement on the full body. This rule is set to BLOCK action with custom response code 403.

config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
